title: Design-Based Confidence Sequences: A General Approach to Risk Mitigation in Panel Experiments
eligible_reason: Statistical methodology paper on anytime-valid inference for time series, switchback and panel experiments (Netflix applications). It does not estimate a DiD or event-study with staggered binary adoption by unit and TWFE; the 'staggered' hit refers to units entering the panel at different times.
design_notes: Contribution is a design-based asymptotic confidence sequence. Empirical content is simulation plus three Netflix experiments, with randomized assignment. arXiv version dated Aug 2026.
estimators_reported: design-based confidence sequences (not a DiD estimator)
screener_notes: Ineligible: methods paper on sequential inference for randomized experiments.
